meta.notes: The dimension Frost Realm: floating islands over the void with snowy plains everywhere, and the overworld sky with day and night, in its own colours (its own dimension type msm_examples:frost_realm_type, copied from minecraft:overworld). The game loads a new dimension when a world opens, so open or reload a world after adding it. Islands leave gaps: the travel function looks up to 64 blocks around you for ground and says so when it finds none.
